## Activity

During July 2022, North City Eye Clinic recorded 404 captures. This activity represents the total number of images submitted by the site during the reporting month. The capture figure provides the basis for reviewing image quality and subsequent grading outcomes.

## Image quality

Of the 404 captures, 6 were assessed as ungradable. The recorded ungradable rate was 1.5. These images could not be used for grading and are reported separately from images that produced a grading outcome. The result provides an indication of the quality of images submitted during July 2022.

## Grading

Grading identified 93 referable results from the activity recorded at North City Eye Clinic. The median lag between capture and grading was 25 days. This is the midpoint of the recorded interval for cases included in grading and provides a summary measure of reporting timeliness for the month.

No new equipment faults were reported during July 2022. Overall, the report records the site’s capture activity, image-quality outcome, referable results and grading turnaround for the month.
